quantifier: For every actual persistent state S that survives the complete registered terminal-first prefix and is an ordinary q=1 G endpoint, an ordinary positive-q G endpoint, a c=3 source-lineage G endpoint, a full-carrier Type-I root or descendant through the first child/second anchor/d=1 relay, a high-C=2 19-phase descendant, any H4 selector branch, or a nonterminal F/G descendant emitted by H4: prove exactly one of FAMILY_EMPTY, TERMINAL, or VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR(E1-E5 with common-admission re-entry).
domain_requirements: actual persistent source state with content-addressed parent identity
complete terminal-first miss receipt for the branch-specific registered prefix
source occurrence and replayable path, never fixture-derived actualness
all H4 selector guards, including branches outside the v1 a_alt=1 clean-q arm
all nonterminal F/G descendants emitted by any admitted H4 arm
excluded_domains: recursive closure of shared H4_c8_atomic targets owned by_F2_atomic_track
shared PersistentSelectorState runtime and family grammar
existing_established_lemmas: t6-persistent-selector-state-v1 conditional admission and induction kernel
open_obligations_preserved: actual positive-q source receipt and terminal-first binding
actual c=3 source-lineage reachability or family emptiness
continuous serialization from G endpoint through postmacro receiver
C2 H3 target serialization and common-admission re-entry
shared atomic target handoff to Agent 3
forbidden_inferences: conditional adapter implies an actual edge
local or fixture control implies quantified totality
checkpoint capacity drop implies parent-to-final-target T5 descent
registry count implies constructor or guard exhaustion
pending_dispatch or candidate_transition is a persistent successor
a bare prime reconstructs an actual parent
H4 a_alt=1 clean-q coverage implies all H4 branches

verified_successor_requires: E1 actual source occurrence, terminal-first and branch precedence
E3 common schema, owner, digest and admission
E4 universal lift on the full leaf
E5 strict parent-to-final-target frozen T5 N^7 ticket
recursive re-entry into the active selector domain
track_closed_only_if: no H4 F/G descendant remains pending or unadmitted
